# Privacy Policy for [COMPANY / WEBSITE NAME]

**Effective date: [DATE]**

## 1. Who we are

[COMPANY NAME] ("we", "us", "our") operates [WEBSITE URL]. We are the data
controller responsible for your personal data.

**Contact:** [EMAIL] · [POSTAL ADDRESS]
*[If applicable: Data Protection Officer / EU or UK representative contact.]*

## 2. What data we collect

We may collect the following categories of personal data:

- **Information you provide** — e.g., [name, email, phone, account details,
  messages, payment information].
- **Information collected automatically** — e.g., [IP address, device/browser
  info, pages visited, cookies and similar technologies].
- **Information from third parties** — e.g., [analytics providers, payment
  processors, social logins].

*[List only what you actually collect.]*

## 3. How and why we use your data

We use your personal data for the following purposes:

| Purpose | Examples | Legal basis (GDPR) |
|---------|----------|--------------------|
| Provide the service | [account, orders, support] | [Contract] |
| Improve the site | [analytics] | [Consent / Legitimate interests] |
| Marketing | [newsletters] | [Consent] |
| Legal compliance | [record‑keeping] | [Legal obligation] |
| Security | [fraud prevention] | [Legitimate interests] |

*[Adapt the purposes and legal bases to your situation.]*

## 4. Cookies and tracking

We use cookies and similar technologies as described in our
[Cookie Policy]([COOKIE POLICY URL]). You can manage your preferences at any time
via [our cookie settings]. *[EU/UK: non‑essential cookies are used only with your
consent.]*

## 5. Who we share your data with

We may share personal data with:

- **Service providers / processors** — e.g., [hosting, analytics, payment,
  email], who process data on our behalf under contract.
- **Legal / regulatory** — where required by law.
- **Business transfers** — e.g., in a merger or acquisition.

We do **not** sell your personal data. *[If you “sell” or “share” under CCPA/CPRA,
disclose this and provide an opt‑out — see the CCPA section below.]*

## 6. International transfers

*[If applicable:]* Your data may be transferred to and processed in [COUNTRIES].
Where we transfer personal data outside [the EEA/UK], we use appropriate
safeguards such as [Standard Contractual Clauses / adequacy decisions].

## 7. How long we keep your data

We keep personal data only as long as necessary for the purposes described, or as
required by law. [Describe retention periods or criteria.]

## 8. How we protect your data

We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your
data, including [encryption in transit (HTTPS), access controls, etc.]. No method
of transmission or storage is completely secure, but we work to protect your data
and to respond to incidents. *[See our security practices.]*

## 9. Your rights

Depending on your location, you may have the right to:

- Access the personal data we hold about you.
- Correct inaccurate data.
- Delete your data ("right to be forgotten").
- Restrict or object to processing.
- Data portability.
- Withdraw consent at any time.
- Opt out of marketing.
- *[EU/UK]* Lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority.

To exercise your rights, contact us at [EMAIL]. We will respond within [the time
required by law, e.g., one month].

## 10. California privacy rights (CCPA/CPRA)

*[If applicable:]* California residents have the right to know, delete, and
correct personal information, and to opt out of the sale or sharing of personal
information. To opt out, use [“Do Not Sell or Share My Personal Information” link/
mechanism]. We honor recognized opt‑out preference signals (e.g., Global Privacy
Control). We do not discriminate against you for exercising your rights.

## 11. Children's privacy

Our site is not directed to children under [AGE], and we do not knowingly collect
their personal data. *[Adapt to COPPA / GDPR age‑of‑consent as applicable.]*

## 12. Changes to this policy

We may update this policy from time to time. We will post the updated version
here with a new effective date and, where appropriate, notify you.

## 13. Contact us

Questions about this policy or your data? Contact us at [EMAIL] or [POSTAL
ADDRESS].
